faq.title: Reference-to-Video FAQ
faq.description: Questions about the guided generation workflow.

items.question: What types of reference materials can I upload?
items.answer: Happy Horse AI supports reference images and reference videos, plus optional first-frame and voice inputs for additional control.

items.question: Can I use more than one reference asset?
items.answer: Yes. The workflow is designed for multiple reference materials when a single asset is not enough to guide style or motion.

items.question: When should I use reference-to-video instead of text-to-video?
items.answer: Use reference-to-video when you need your final clip to follow a specific visual direction, source material, or motion cue more closely.

items.question: What output settings are available?
items.answer: Reference-to-video supports 720p and 1080p output, plus common aspect ratios depending on the project setup.
